outcome: Incidence of surfactant deficiency respiratory distress syndrome (SRDS)
cohort: 117 term and near-term neonates (mean gestational age = 36.8 weeks) diagnosed with SRDS, compared to 60 preterm neonates with SRDS (mean gestational age = 27.5 weeks)
finding: Surfactant deficiency respiratory distress syndrome (SRDS) is not uncommon among full-term and near-term neonates (10/1000 live births), with maternal diabetes mellitus and cesarean section being the most common associated risk factors, and affecting males more than females.
mod_finding: Cesarean section is a risk factor for SRDS in term and near-term neonates.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight: 2.8 kg in term/near-term group vs 1.1 kg in preterm group
